data.body:
FIX MERGED. Gerrit change 2601 ('Address bare test remotes with --git-dir', commit cfe6d3df784e / patchset 2 89afbe561f26) reached LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 and was submitted; it is on main.

WHAT LANDED, and it is broader than the ticket originally scoped:
 - tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_atomic_completion_close.py -- added _bare_git(repo, *args) using
   'git --git-dir' beside the existing _git ('git -C'), both delegating to _run_git. Routed the
   bare-remote sites through it. NOTE: the ticket said 5 sites; the tree actually had EIGHT across
   those 5 tests. Non-bare callers (tracker, writer, tmp_path) deliberately untouched, since a
   blanket -C -> --git-dir swap would have broken them.
 - tests/interfaces/test_tracker_footprint_cli.py -- THE SWEEP FOUND A SECOND FILE WITH THE SAME
   LATENT DEFECT, 4 more sites and 2 more strict-config failures. This ticket did not know about it.
   That is AC4's mechanism working before it even landed.
 - scripts/check_bare_repository_discovery.py was NOT added. The detector was folded into
   tests/integration/test_bare_repository_fixture_portability_heldout.py instead -- see below.

AC1: 17 passed under safe.bareRepository=explicit (was 5 failed / 12 passed).
AC2: 546 passed for tests/interfaces/lifecycle; both files green under default git config too.
AC3: mutation demonstrated -- reverting line 411 to _git(remote, ...) produced
       'tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_atomic_completion_close.py:411: bare repository remote
        addressed via _git()'
     and the guard went RED; restored, green. Re-demonstrated against the restructured guard.
AC4: THE HAND-MAINTAINED ALLOWLIST IS GONE. _FIXTURE_NODES deleted; coverage is now a tree-wide AST
     sweep over every tests/**/*.py, deriving bare identifiers from the last operand after --bare,
     from cwd when the flag takes no operand, from factory results bound at the caller's name, and
     from arguments at parameter positions the callee creates a bare repo at. test_tracker_footprint_cli
     is the proof it now catches unregistered files.
AC5: make lint exit 0 with the sweep wired in; make typecheck clean (754 files).

WHY THE DETECTOR MOVED INTO THE EXISTING GUARD rather than becoming a new scripts/check_*.py: a new
gate script registers as a new ci_gate named by path, and at the time we believed a mechanism-ok
marker could not satisfy the ratchet's unit tests. THAT BELIEF WAS MINE AND IT WAS WRONG -- see the
retraction on a1f1; a correct marker does satisfy both assertions. The restructure is still the right
call on its own merits (ticket 3476 created that guard file for this exact rule, and its allowlist was
the defect, so repairing it in place is narrower than adding a second mechanism beside it) -- but it
was chosen partly under a false constraint, and that should be visible rather than implied.

Scope call preserved: tests/scripts/test_reconcile_bridge_push_retry.py:129 is left alone. Its
'-c safe.bareRepository=all' is the deliberate escape ticket 3476 preserved, it passes under strict
config, and the sweep exempts that form. The plan reviewer blocked twice until that was recognised as
an opt-in rather than a defect.
